description.value: HI Kelowna is part of the Hostelling International Canada network, one of ten HI hostels in British Columbia and a well-established budget option on the Okanagan cycling corridor. Situated on Harvey Avenue, Kelowna's main arterial road, it is within reach of the city's lakefront, wineries, and the Kettle Valley Rail Trail. As a dedicated hostel, it caters to independent travellers including touring cyclists passing through one of BC's premier cycling regions.
